title: Worth your time!
text: Carlos was very knowledgeable, nice and interesting.  At the end of the tour, he helped us get a table at the restaurant in the park.
author: Kaye_I

title: Best tour ever!!!
text: Wonderful experience with the best tour guide ever!! A must do tour to learn about the area and the rich history of Spain and Sevilla. We have traveled a lot with many tour guides and Juan was by far the best!
author: Kim_O

title: Wonderful tour with Beatriz
text: Beatriz was a wonderful guide. She showed us many monuments and introduced us to Seville. Her knowledge and passion for her home city shone through. Highly recommend.
author: Kate_T

title: Beatriz was an amazing guide.
text: Beatriz was a wonderful guide. She is a lovely woman with a wealth of knowledge and a true passion for  her city. I would highly recommend using her services if you have a chance.
author: katet193

title: Perfect tour for us
text: Beatriz is an outstanding guide. We booked a private tour of Seville on our cruise ship. During the drive from Cádiz to Seville she took time to get to know us and understand how we liked to tour. She then customized our itinerary to focus on walking, parks, architecture, the things we like best! She is knowledgeable, personable and approachable. We were in Europe for a month and this was the best tour we had! Thank you
author: Retired_prf

title: A fascinating city brought to life by an experienced, knowledgeable and enthusiastic gui!de. A true highlight
text: Our guide for this "Private tour of Seville highlights"  was Alba Delgado. She was simply amazing. Alba met  the two of us at the hotel for this walking tour. From the first minute it was apparent that she was engaging, extremely knowledgeable and had the ability to seek out our specific interests and discuss them, while also showing and teaching things that we were unaware of in a manner that piqued our interest in an unexpected and  fascinating manner. author: Rebrodney

title: Beatrice Perez Garcia- review of a lovely day spent in Seville
text: Beatrice is undoubtedly one of the best guides we ever met during our travels across Europe. We visited Seville on 27 th of July. She was literally at the Railway station waiting to meet us when we got to Seville from Madrid. Her warmth, devotion to her work and tremendous knowledge about the history, Architecture and social aspects of each monument, and the city in general, are exemplary. Very important, she made us feel safe and comfortable from the get go , which was important for us as we are an older couple. I commend her unreservedly to all those who wish to understand this lovely city.
author: BN1603

title: Unforgettable Experience!
text: Beatriz Pérez is more than just a tour guide in Seville; she's an experience maker! Her deep knowledge of history and culture transforms every landmark into a captivating journey. Beatriz creates a welcoming atmosphere, ideal for relaxed exploration. She happily adjusts the pace for photo opportunities and readily answers any questions that arise. Beatriz is the key to unlocking Seville's magic. Highly recommended!
author: Cruiser09525593967

title: Seville - culture tour
text: Beatriz showed me the House of Pilates , the Fine Arts museum and the Church  of La Macarena  . Her tours are well planned and very informative . She is very friendly which was a huge plus . I thoroughly enjoyed the tours I booked with her .
author: sonalr239

title: Sevilla may 2024
text: With Beatriz we saw many sights which we could never have done on our own. Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic in every aspect. Congratulations Beatriz. We'll meet again in our next visit to Sevilla
